approved_intents_identity_present.name: approved_intents_identity_present
approved_intents_identity_present.value: length(btrim(intent_id)) > 0 and length(btrim(idempotency_key)) > 0 and length(btrim(correlation_id)) > 0 and length(btrim(economic_action_id)) > 0

approved_intents_amounts_authorize_somet.name: approved_intents_amounts_authorize_something
approved_intents_amounts_authorize_somet.value: quantity_base > 0 and max_spend_base > 0 and min_acceptable_receipt_base >= 0 and permitted_residual_base >= 0 and permitted_residual_base <= max_spend_base

approved_intents_scale_range.name: approved_intents_scale_range
approved_intents_scale_range.value: input_asset_scale between 0 and 36 and output_asset_scale between 0 and 36 and numeraire_asset_scale between 0 and 36

approved_intents_net_edge_hurdle.name: approved_intents_net_edge_hurdle
approved_intents_net_edge_hurdle.value: (net_edge_basis = 'hurdle') = (minimum_net_edge_base is not null) and (minimum_net_edge_base is null or expected_net_edge_base >= minimum_net_edge_base)

approved_intents_chain_simulated.name: approved_intents_chain_simulated
approved_intents_chain_simulated.value: chain_id is null or chain_simulation_passed is true

approved_intents_provenance_present.name: approved_intents_provenance_present
approved_intents_provenance_present.value: length(btrim(policy_version)) > 0 and length(btrim(strategy_version)) > 0 and length(btrim(portfolio_snapshot_version)) > 0 and length(btrim(market_snapshot_version)) > 0 and length(btrim(fee_snapshot_version)) > 0

execution_attempts_scale_range.name: execution_attempts_scale_range
execution_attempts_scale_range.value: input_asset_scale between 0 and 36 and output_asset_scale between 0 and 36

execution_attempts_instants_ordered.name: execution_attempts_instants_ordered
execution_attempts_instants_ordered.value: reconciled_at is null or reconciled_at >= submitted_at

intent_cost_components_scale_range.name: intent_cost_components_scale_range
intent_cost_components_scale_range.value: native_asset_scale between 0 and 36 and numeraire_asset_scale between 0 and 36

intent_dispatch_outbox_instants_ordered.name: intent_dispatch_outbox_instants_ordered
intent_dispatch_outbox_instants_ordered.value: dispatched_at is null or dispatched_at >= enqueued_at

journal_entries_no_self_reversal.name: journal_entries_no_self_reversal
journal_entries_no_self_reversal.value: reverses_entry_id is null or reverses_entry_id <> entry_id
